frame: Who: every seller, opening one buyer's conversation from Messages, Today or a push. Carol reads every word; a flipper wants the draft and Send.
Came to: read what the buyer said, see what the agent answered or holds for them, and answer an offer where it was made.
A mistake costs most where a reply states something untrue about the item, an offer is accepted by accident, or money moves off the site.

Ways out (spec/ways-out.md §6.3): Edit the draft or Take over, which stops drafts here until it is handed back and leaves offers to the Plan; Correct it on anything sent for you drafts a fix instead of sending one; Block with Undo; see the site's own copy of the thread; open on the site.
In the loop: a draft waits for Send; an offer waits for Accept or Counter; a possible scam waits for Block. Only facts the person set are sent for them, and each says why.

decisions.decision: The buyer's name is the headline, with the item as a card under it
decisions.why: Who you are talking to comes first, as in Messages; the card opens the item.

decisions.decision: The buyer's bubbles are gray on the left, the person's white with an edge on the right
decisions.why: iMessage's sides, while black stays reserved for the one act (C4).

decisions.decision: A time shows only after a gap of more than 30 minutes, and at the end
decisions.why: As iMessage does, so a short exchange reads as one.

decisions.decision: What the agent sent says "Sent for you" and opens why, with Correct it and Ask me first
decisions.why: Every automatic act explains itself and can be stopped (ways-out, "Stop doing that for me").

decisions.decision: An offer in the thread is the same card as on Today, after the message that made it
decisions.why: The same actions in both places (brief), so an offer is answered where it was read.

decisions.decision: The draft sits in place under the last message, dotted where the agent guessed
decisions.why: spec/features/assist.md: dotted until the person changes a word, solid after.

decisions.decision: "Take over" swaps the draft for the composer and says offers still follow the Plan; More holds "Hand it back"
decisions.why: ways-out §6.3: Take over stops automatic replies in that thread until the person hands it back; offers are not messages.

decisions.decision: A possible scam is a calm block of text with the reason and Block as the black pill
decisions.why: The suggested act is the first decision in view (C4); calm, because a flag is not a verdict.

decisions.decision: Each message on the person's side says who wrote it: You, Sent for you, or Drafted and sent by you
The draft shows a chip per fact it states, with its source
decisions.why: ways-out §6.3: chips for the facts it used with where each came from.

decisions.decision: "See the site's copy" in More opens the site's own screenshot of the thread; the demo has none, so the sheet says so
decisions.why: edge-cases §16, "Proof the agent got it right" (Ben, 05:24); never draw a fake of a site's screen. The label avoids the site's name in words (kit, SiteBadge).
